description: This file defines the Service class in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a web service API model with methods for creating serializers, error parsers, parsers, and accessing service metadata, operations, shapes, paginators, and waiters.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a web service API model with methods for creating serializers, error parsers, parsers, and accessing service metadata, operations, shapes, paginators, and waiters.

methods.name: createSerializer
methods.description: Creates a request serializer for the provided API object based on its protocol.

methods.name: createErrorParser
methods.description: Creates an error parser for the given protocol.

methods.name: createParser
methods.description: Creates a parser for the API based on its protocol.

methods.name: getServiceFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the service.

methods.name: getServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version of the service.

methods.name: getEndpointPrefix
methods.description: Returns the endpoint prefix of the service.

methods.name: getSigningName
methods.description: Returns the signing name used by the service.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Returns the default signature version, typically 'v4'.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used by the service.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Returns the UID string used by the service.

methods.name: hasOperation
methods.description: Checks if a specific operation exists by name.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Retrieves an operation by name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns all operations defined in the service.

methods.name: getErrorShapes
methods.description: Returns all error shapes of the service.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves service metadata or a specific key.

methods.name: getPaginators
methods.description: Returns available paginator configurations.

methods.name: hasPaginator
methods.description: Checks if a paginator exists by name.

methods.name: getPaginatorConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a paginator configuration by name.

methods.name: getWaiters
methods.description: Returns available waiter configurations.

methods.name: hasWaiter
methods.description: Checks if a waiter exists by name.

methods.name: getWaiterConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a waiter configuration by name.

methods.name: getShapeMap
methods.description: Returns the shape map used by the API.

methods.name: getClientContextParams
methods.description: Returns all client context parameters.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the API provider callable.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the service's API definition.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the service's API definition, marking the model as modified.

methods.name: isModifiedModel
methods.description: Indicates whether the service's definition has been modified.
